title_gate.instructions: Screen each listing against its configured search. Reject clear title/spec mismatches and do not invent facts. Return JSON: {results:[{external_id,pass,reason}]}. Make reason <=8 words.

taste_judgment.instructions: Compare the listing only with same-category references. Ignore price and popularity. Return JSON: {verdict,reason}, with verdict like, dislike, or uncertain; reason <=8 words.
